player.keys_help: Space or K play/pause · ← → 5 s · J / L 10 s · , and . one frame · Home / End · I / O set export start and end
player.veil.locked_body: Decrypt the event above to play it here.
player.veil.bad_body: The file is probably incomplete, usually from removing the USB drive while the vehicle was writing.
player.range.label: Range
player.range.sel_note: {len} selected. Tap Start or End to set it at the playhead, or press I / O.
player.export.overlay_sub: Speed, power and battery, plus gear, steering and accelerator from the clip.
player.export.no_libass: Unavailable: ffmpeg lacks libass, so exports have no overlay.
player.report.no_telemetry: No overlay: no driving data for this range
player.report.sei_only: TeslaMate unreachable; the overlay shows only the clip's own data
player.report.short: {cam} at {time} is {dur} s (others {expected} s); it freezes until the next segment.
player.evidence.title: Evidence package
player.evidence.body: Original footage, event details, driving data (CSV) and checksums in one ZIP for your insurer or the police.
player.evidence.note: Downloads start right away. Long events can be several GB, so the browser shows the amount downloaded, not a percentage.
player.align.ok: Offset {offset} s, average error {rmse} {unit} over {samples} samples. Saved for the HUD and exports.
player.sei.heading: Driving data
player.missing: This clip is no longer in the library
decrypt.title: {n} of {total} clips need decrypting to play
decrypt.body: Your vehicle encrypts dashcam footage with a key tied to your Tesla account. Decrypt it here: only each clip's header goes to Tesla to get its key; the video never leaves this machine.
decrypt.token_help: This token can only fetch decryption keys — it can't control or read your vehicle. Used once in memory, never stored.
decrypt.keep_sub: Saved next to each clip as .mp4.enc. Delete them once the decrypted footage plays.
decrypt.preview_note: One entry per clip: the VIN, key ID, timestamp, and the wrapped and public keys from the clip's header. No video.
decrypt.busy_other: Another event is decrypting. Try again when it finishes.
decrypt.done_kept: Encrypted originals kept as .mp4.enc. Delete them once the decrypted clips play.
decrypt.nothing: Nothing left to decrypt in this event.
usb.import.desc_recent: Uploads these driving clips and merges them with recent clips already on the hub.
usb.import.desc_locked: These clips are encrypted. Import them, then decrypt on the hub with your Tesla account.
usb.veil.locked_body: Import this clip, then decrypt it on the hub with your Tesla account.
dashcam.note.shadowed_body: Clips in {hidden} aren't shown because the library reads {base}. Move them there and rescan.
dashcam.note.locked_body: No frames can be read from these, usually because of encryption: since software 2026.20, dashcam footage is encrypted with a key tied to your Tesla account. Open a clip to decrypt it here. An interrupted copy looks the same; if it isn't encrypted, copy it again.
dashcam.note.skipped_body: Their names aren't dates and times the vehicle writes, or they can't be read.
dashcam.note.timeouts_body: Usually a slow network share, not broken clips, so they aren't counted as unreadable. Rescan to try again.
dashcam.empty.filter: No clips of this type yet.
sdc.heading: Dashcam
sdc.tz_why: Clip names use the vehicle's local time without a zone; a wrong zone shifts overlays and TeslaMate matching by whole hours. Change it with TESLACAM_TZ.
sdc.intro: teslausb is a Raspberry Pi that replaces your vehicle's USB drive. When the vehicle gets home, it copies new clips to this hub.
sdc.never_sub: Add the two lines below to the Pi to report every run here.
sdc.error_hint: Common on 32-bit Raspberry Pi OS since software 2025.44: repeater and pillar clips get skipped. Reinstall teslausb on 64-bit Raspberry Pi OS (see docs/TESLAUSB.md).
sdc.hook.title: Notify the hub after each run
sdc.hook.intro: Paste these two lines into teslausb_setup_variables.conf on the Pi. The hub then rescans as soon as new clips arrive, not within a minute.
sdc.hook.copy_manual: Couldn't copy. The lines are selected: press Ctrl+C or ⌘C.
sdc.hook.rotate_lead: The current token stops working now. Until the Pi has the new lines, the hub won't hear about runs, but still finds new clips within a minute.
sdc.hook.note: This token only lets the Pi request a rescan. Never put the portal password on the Pi; it travels with the vehicle.
sdc.hook.localhost: This page uses a local address the Pi can't reach. Use this computer's LAN address instead of
sdc.pi.title: Pi on your network
sdc.pi.intro: Optional. With its address, the hub shows the Pi's status and can ask it to sync Sentry events recorded in the garage right away. Username and password are needed only if WEB_USERNAME is set on the Pi.
sdc.pi.password_ph: Only if the Pi requires one
sdc.pi.password_saved: Saved; leave blank to keep it
sdc.pi.sync_ok: The Pi syncs when idle at home, briefly disconnecting the drive from the vehicle.
player.sei.scope: Segment from {time}, recorded by the vehicle
sdc.pi.err_timeout: The Pi timed out. Check it's home and on Wi-Fi.
sdc.pi.err_connect: Can't reach the Pi: wrong address, or it's away from home.
sdc.pi.err_auth: The Pi needs a password. Enter the teslausb web username and password above.
sdc.pi.err_json: The Pi answered, but not with teslausb status.
player.export.locked: Decrypt this event first; none of its clips can be read.
align.no_overlap: The clip and TeslaMate's data don't overlap in time.
align.no_sei: This clip has too little driving data (older software, a parked Sentry clip, or encrypted) to calibrate automatically.
align.flat_speed: Speed barely changes in this clip (cruising or parked), so any offset fits. Pick a drive with speeding up and slowing down.
align.no_telemetry: TeslaMate has too little driving data for that time (was the vehicle moving?).
align.poor_fit: Unreliable fit: at the best offset ({off} s), speeds still differ by {rmse} km/h (limit {max}). The clip and TeslaMate's record may be different drives. Offset unchanged.
align.no_minimum: Unreliable fit: the best offset ({off} s) isn't clearly better than others ({rmse} vs a median of {median} km/h). Offset unchanged.
align.pick_car: Several vehicles on this account: choose one in the player first.
